title: DROID-OOD Privileged Phase Distillation v1
summary: Distills training-only pseudo-progress and recorded robot phase signals into visual-only endpoint features; SC47 learned contact/lift process but remained weak on terminal success.

mechanisms.name: Privileged Phase Distillation
mechanisms.description: Uses dense pseudo-progress plus recorded gripper and Cartesian phase signals only during training to supervise task-conditioned multi-view visual sequences, then evaluates with video and task text alone under a split-conformal endpoint reducer.
inputs: Training: task text, three-view video, pseudo-progress, gripper position, Cartesian position, and success labels. Evaluation provider: task text and three-view video only.
outputs: Visual-only success, failure, or UNKNOWN plus distilled progress/contact/lift/release sequences.
mechanisms.limitations: SC47 missed absolute accuracy, coverage, and success-recall gates. Progress, gripper closure, and lift were learnable, but speed/opening derivatives and correct final object state were not. Robot signals are privileged proxies, reward_progress is pseudo-progress, and the consumed validation split must not be retuned.
